		📚 Introduction
	

Ultra-FineWeb-L1 is a large-scale English web corpus built from Common Crawl snapshots. Within UltraData's L0-L4 tiered data management framework, it serves as the L1 filtered layer for general web data and provides the foundation for subsequent L2 selection and L3 refinement.
